tours.title: How the admin works
tours.description: Create, edit and publish tours without a deploy.

steps.title: Tours are data
steps.body: Every tour you see in your systems is defined here, as config. Edit it, save it, and users get the new version on their next page load. No frontend deploy.

steps.title: Your systems
steps.body: Each system embeds the engine once, with its own key. Tours and progress are kept separate per system.

steps.title: Tours for one system
steps.body: An app can have any number of tours: onboarding, what's new, feature deep-dives. Each has its own id and trigger.

steps.title: Draft or live
steps.body: Only published tours are served to the app. Unpublish to pull a tour instantly.

steps.title: Steps, in order
steps.body: Drag to reorder. Each step points at one element, from a tiny field to a whole modal.

steps.title: Point at anything
steps.body: A CSS selector picks the element to spotlight. Add a Page for multi-page apps and the tour carries on across the page load.

steps.title: Actions between steps
steps.body: Navigate, open a modal or switch a tab before highlighting, so the target is on screen. All declarative: config can't run code.

steps.title: Or edit the JSON
steps.body: The same config as raw JSON, for bulk edits or copying a tour between systems.

steps.title: Save and it's live
steps.body: Saving validates the tour on the server. If it's published, it's live on the next page load.

steps.title: Replay any time
steps.body: This tour runs on the same engine as your systems' tours, inside an Angular app. Start it again from here whenever you like.
